eyebrow: Two modes Power BI already had
code:
# Import:      a refreshed COPY, fast, inside Power BI
# DirectQuery: a LIVE query, every interaction,
#              only as fast as the source engine
#
# Every deployment before Fabric picked one, and its tradeoff.
caption: Speed vs. freshness -- always a compromise, until now.

code:
Import:      Power BI's own copy      <- refreshed periodically
DirectQuery: Power BI -> engine -> Delta table  <- live, slower
Direct Lake: Power BI -> Delta Parquet directly <- live AND fast
caption: A real third option -- not a compromise between the other two.

eyebrow: Delta's transaction log, paying off again
code:
# Databricks Lesson 17: _delta_log/ tells any reader
# exactly which Parquet files belong to the CURRENT version.
#
# Direct Lake reads that same log to know precisely
# which files to read -- no engine required in between.
caption: The exact mechanism behind time travel (Lesson 21) and safe writes (Lesson 18).
